_comment: Scan-root liveness. Every COVERAGE-BEARING root a gate policy declares must resolve to a real path (or, for a glob, match at least one). A dead root means the gate scans less than it claims and reports GREEN over an empty set - and because the fleet's anti-narrowing ratchet forbids REMOVING a root, a reorg move that empties one leaves it permanently dead AND unremovable. Keys are the FULL JSON POINTER, not the leaf name: `roots` appears at three different nesting levels inside rust-first-automation-policy.json alone, so leaf-name keying would collapse distinct declarations and let one baselined entry silently tolerate another. Only coverage-bearing keys are in scope; vocabulary lists (exclude_prefixes, allowed_paths, forbidden_prefixes) are excluded because a dead entry there excludes or permits nothing. forward_declarations hold paths declared deliberately BEFORE they exist - flagging those would punish declaring a reorg destination ahead of the move - and a forward declaration whose path LANDS must be retired so it cannot become a permanent unaudited exemption. baselined_dead_roots is FROZEN and shrink-only.

_provenance.policy: shrink-only; a NEW dead root fails, and a landed forward declaration must be retired

ci/facade/caller-supplied-authorization/.reason: AUTHZ SCAN-SCOPE PRE-WIDENING (ADR-0562 §10.29 mandate, applied ahead of the move rather than after it). ADR-0615 relocates 33 product dirs from oya/<product>/ to app/<product>/; oya IS in this gate's scan_roots and app was NOT, so that move would have silently removed the entire product surface from the ADR-0582 caller-supplied-authz class-fix with no CI red — the gate has no per-crate expectation, so a departed crate is invisible. Declared while app/ holds zero crates, which is the only moment the widening is provably zero-delta (no new findings, no baseline churn). Created by the first app-tier move.

Same pre-widening as app/ above. base/ is the ADR-0562 shared floor (>=3 capability consumers); a primitive there can carry an authorization DTO, so the class-fix must see it from the moment it lands. Created by the first libs/ consolidation move.

Same pre-widening as app/ above. Completes the meta-root set already represented here by kernel/ and governance/, so no destination root of the reorg is outside this gate's scan universe. Created when build/ lands its first crate.

Same pre-widening as app/ above. policy is the capability ADR-0615 extracted from iam and is where PBAC/PDP code lands — the single root where a caller-supplied-authz defect would be most consequential. Created when the policy capability lands its first crate.

ci/facade/endpoint-authorization-coverag.reason: AUTHZ SCAN-SCOPE PRE-WIDENING, sibling of the dto-authz-trust entry above and for the same measured reason: oya IS in this gate's scan_roots and app was NOT, so the ADR-0615 33-product move would have silently removed the product surface from the issue #770 / AUTH-005 unauthenticated-HTTP-control-plane gate. AUTH-005 was the dominant finding of the whole-repo review, so this is the highest-consequence instance of the ADR-0562 §10.29 class. Declared while app/ is empty and the widening is provably zero-delta. Created by the first app-tier move.
Same pre-widening as app/ above. A shared-floor primitive can expose an HTTP control plane; new-surface detection must cover base/ before it holds code.
Same pre-widening as app/ above. Completes the meta-root set already represented here by kernel/ and governance/. Created when build/ lands its first crate.

Same pre-widening as app/ above. The policy capability (ADR-0615, extracted from iam) will expose policy-decision endpoints; an unauthenticated control plane there is the worst case this gate exists to block.

ci/facade/module-membership/capability-m.reason: ADR-0562 capability-first destination. Declared ahead of creation so the first product app can land without a policy edit; module-membership already lists app/ in meta_directories and allowed_top_level_dirs. Created by the first app-tier move.
ADR-0562 capability-first destination for the shared floor. Declared ahead of creation for the same reason as app/; created by the first libs/ consolidation move.
Declared capability in the ADR-0562 closed registry with no directory yet; created when the policy-pack capability lands its first crate.

ci/facade/layer-dependency-acyclicity/ti.reason: Same declared-but-unbuilt `policy` capability as above, expressed as a crate glob. Kept so the tier rules apply the moment the capability lands, rather than being retrofitted after crates already exist there.
